Sync.event_within.detail: An explicit infinite execution starts with two writes and two incoming frames; both producers append work every iteration forever. The second original frame is selected before iteration 4. Exact-prefix and fallback checks reject the old write-starvation behavior. Bound counts completed chooser iterations; native thread/channel operation and I/O completion remain outside this theorem.

Tick.cofinal.detail: Positive 200ms period with the explicit infinite sampled clock now(i)=200*i and last(i)=200*(i-1). The fixture proves the exact runtime Tick.next update and unbounded sampled time, then applies the cofinal-ticks theorem. Checks cover just-before and exactly-at deadline. This does not prove OS scheduling or native I/O termination.
